human_instruction: Anthony Edgar instructed the project to proceed after all intended repository pull requests were merged or resolved.
objective: Recover and inspect the exact historical PR #92 protected verify-only workflow run and sanitized artifact without rerunning Azure verification.

scope.target_workflow_name: Verify ServiceTracer demo API extension write permission attempt 2

evidence_requirements: exact historical workflow run identity and URL
run status, conclusion, attempt, and timestamps
artifact identity, digest, size, expiry state, and run binding
ARM validation and extension-only What-If result when present
before and after resource inventory comparison when present
public health before and after when present
missing or conflicting evidence preserved as unverified

one_shot.consumed_when: The recovery workflow attempts to enumerate the exact historical run and artifact, regardless of recovery outcome.

claim_boundary: Historical GitHub evidence recovery != new Azure verification. Recovered run success != deployment authorization. Missing evidence != failed permission.
